title: Stopbar Contact v1
description: A destination registry entry as served by /v1/contacts (LLD §4.1, §6.4, CS-134). Mirrors internal/model.Contact. GET /v1/contacts returns {"contacts": [Contact]}. status is derived from the server clock when read: pending_approval (quorum of signed approvals not yet met), cooling_off (approved, before active_from), active (counts as a known destination).

requested_by_agent.description: The requester's agent id; an approver key bound to it cannot approve (approval-signature-v1 §7).

votes.description: Live signed approvals toward the quorum (CS-151, approval-signature-v1 §3a), one per approver owner, until it is met.

expires_at.description: at + 1h: after this the vote no longer counts.

quorum.description: Distinct approver owners needed to approve this addition.

similar_to.description: Every existing entry (active or pending) this address looks like, computed when it was requested (address poisoning).
